package handler

import "testing"

func clearScenario(t *testing.T, f *scenarioFixture) {
	t.Helper()
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		f.do(t, 0, "vote")
		f.do(t, 1, "vote")
	}
}
func TestScenarioTeamBarrier(t *testing.T) {
	f := newScenario(t)
	f.do(t, 0, "vote")
	if f.state(t).Stage != 0 {
		t.Fatal("advanced without team")
	}
	f.refuse(t, 0, f.command(t, 0, "vote"))
	f.do(t, 1, "vote")
	if f.state(t).Stage != 1 {
		t.Fatal("did not advance")
	}
}
func TestScenarioRewardExactlyOnce(t *testing.T) {
	f := newScenario(t)
	f.refuse(t, 0, f.command(t, 0, "claim"))
	clearScenario(t, f)
	c := f.command(t, 0, "claim")
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		r, err := f.send(0, c)
		if err != nil || r.Reward != 10 {
			t.Fatal(r, err)
		}
	}
	if f.players[0].Dao().GetCoins() != 10 {
		t.Fatal("double paid")
	}
	f.refuse(t, 0, f.command(t, 0, "claim"))
	f.do(t, 1, "claim")
	if f.players[1].Dao().GetCoins() != 10 {
		t.Fatal("teammate unpaid")
	}
}
func TestScenarioRewardRollsBackBothEntities(t *testing.T) {
	f := newScenario(t)
	clearScenario(t, f)
	f.committer.reject.Store(true)
	f.refuse(t, 0, f.command(t, 0, "claim"))
	f.committer.reject.Store(false)
	f.do(t, 0, "claim")
	if f.players[0].Dao().GetCoins() != 10 {
		t.Fatal("reward lost")
	}
}
func TestScenarioSeedSurvivesReload(t *testing.T) {
	f := newScenario(t)
	f.do(t, 0, "vote")
	s := f.state(t)
	c := f.command(t, 1, "vote")
	c.Choice = 1
	if _, err := s.Apply(f.players[1].ID(), c, f.now.Load()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := f.send(1, c); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	live := f.state(t)
	if live.Seed != s.Seed || live.Stage != s.Stage {
		t.Fatal("reconnect rerolled route")
	}
}
